meter.title: Total meter deltas
meter.description:
A workshop records signed changes in a meter reading. Implement totalDelta(deltas) to return the combined change. An empty record has a combined change of zero.

For the original demonstration record [4, -9, 12], the combined change is 7.
meter.assertions:
def check(candidate):
    assert candidate(deltas=[4, -9, 12]) == 7
    assert candidate(deltas=[]) == 0
    assert candidate(deltas=[-8, -3]) == -11
    assert candidate(deltas=[5, -5, 5]) == 5
